headline: izna to release special single 'IWALY' on Nov 25
sub: A gift for fans marking the group's 2nd debut anniversary
source: Source: izna official X, via Korean media
caption:
izna is celebrating their 2nd debut anniversary with a special single! 💌

The group revealed a teaser photo for 'IWALY (Remain in Love)', a special track releasing on Nov 25 — the day izna marks two years since debut. Members Mai, Bang Jeemin, Koko, Yoo Sarang, Choi Jungeun and Jeong Saebi are also busy with their solo tour 'WHO DAT GIRL'.

📌 Source: izna official X, via Korean media (Nocut News, Ilgan Sports)
